name: contract-layout-page-tests
goal: Layouts use page screenshot cases at every declared viewport with a labelled placeholder in their real child slot

evidence: Layouts use the existing page test form, not a sixth shape. Generated layout states must render a labelled Child content placeholder through the real children slot and match the full page at desktop, tablet and mobile.

The existing scaffold case checked that a layout screenshot call existed but did not require page capture or a labelled child placeholder. The guidance and validator cases omitted layouts. Strengthen those existing cases with no new test declarations.
